name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.0 degrees south of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 22 times in 7 visits over 77 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 44 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.2 days starting 2025-12-15, at wavelengths from 0.76 to 4.79 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
